attr.title: Space Grunts
attr.desc: Explore hostile space facilities and use weapons and items in turn-based tactical battles.
attr.inst: Install SpaceGrunts.zip, then copy your owned spacegrunts.dat into the installed spacegrunts folder. See spacegrunts.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.
